findings.title: Excludes constant not in diff
findings.detail: The unstaged branch now runs `git diff HEAD -- ...REVIEW_ARTIFACT_EXCLUDES`, but REVIEW_ARTIFACT_EXCLUDES is not defined or shown in this diff. Cannot verify the pathspecs, that they match the commit-walk branch, or that they cover nested fixture evidence under known-bad-fixtures/** and orchestrator/test/fixtures/**. Unverified exclusion list means the fix does not pass.

findings.title: New regression test not proven green
findings.detail: Author added `a working tree dirtied only by evidence falls through to the product commit`, but this review has no test run output, exit code, or log. Presence of a test is not proof it passes. PASS requires verification; this claim fails closed.

findings.title: Test covers only root evidence path
findings.detail: The only dirty artifact is `evidence/measurement-meta.json` at the temp repo root. No case for nested fixture paths, mixed product+artifact unstaged edits, or empty fallthrough when HEAD has no non-artifact product files. Coverage gap is explicit in the test body.

findings.title: Two-run timestamps collapsed to identical
findings.detail: Both runs now use `at: 2026-08-12T22:29:35.406Z`; previously they were 712Z vs 713Z. Same collapse appears in u-build-succeeds (both 22:29:27.684Z) and proc-design-options (both 22:29:57.922Z). Re-stamping wiped the 1ms separation that proved two distinct runs; that is the known meas-two-run false-pass/fail class.

findings.title: Commit is mostly evidence re-stamp noise
findings.detail: Aside from independentReview.ts and one test, the commit only rewrites measurement-meta timestamps and nonces (e.g. path `/api/__definitely_absent_0e63c3b6ce04ce87`). That is the exact dirt the comment says used to poison the judge. Shipping a fix for evidence-only noise inside a commit dominated by evidence-only noise, without proving excludes strip these nested paths, is unverified and fails.

findings.title: Product fix itself is one unproven line
findings.detail: The only behavioral product change is adding `-- ...REVIEW_ARTIFACT_EXCLUDES` to the unstaged `git diff HEAD`. Comment asserts parity with the commit path and end of the evidence-only judge finding. Neither parity nor end-to-end judge behavior is demonstrated in the diff. Claim does not pass.
